name: RememberAboutPlayer
description: Save one new, lasting fact about the REAL person playing the game (not their in-game character) to your long-term notes about them. Use it when they share something personal that is worth remembering next time: their name, work, people in their life, interests, plans, preferences, or how they want you to talk. Do not use it for small talk, in-game events, or things you already know.
note: Server-side tool (src/companion_profile.py via src/actions/server_tools.py): appends to about_me.txt in the Mantella user folder, never sent to the game. Offered only when companion_enabled is on and the player talks one-on-one with the companion.

fact.description: One short third-person line using their name or 'they' (never guess gender), e.g. 'Works night shifts as a nurse.' or 'Has a sister called Mia in Hamburg.'
